title: fix(react): the objectui#9874 disagreement row types its retired-`view` fixture through the spec schema — the one diagnostic the Spec Main Shape Gate still reports
body:
Dedupe words: `useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault` · `AUTHORED_WITHOUT_MODE` · `SpecAuthoredInput NavigationConfigSchema` · `retiredKey navigation view` · `Spec Main Shape Gate one diagnostic`

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) as a **sub-issue of #9860**, whose domain it inherits — the in-flight derivation exception, ⛔ not a lane routing decision. ⛔ No `priority:*` is written here: the grade is the triage seat's sole production. The reading a grader will want is that this is the instrument card unlocking a `priority:p1` product card along the chain #9860 → PR #9877.

## The reading, first-hand

`Spec Main Shape Gate` on PR #9877 (run 35505224765, job 106063778695, completed 2026-09-20T10:41:06Z) is **RED with exactly one diagnostic**, 80 of 81 turbo tasks succeeding:

```
packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx(76)
  TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'.
```

compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from `objectstack-ai/objectstack@4efb988a9410`.

Line 75–76 of that file:

```ts
const AUTHORED_WITHOUT_MODE: SpecAuthoredInput<typeof NavigationConfigSchema> = {
  view: 'summary_view',
};
```

and on objectstack `origin/main`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1971`:

```ts
  /**
   * [#16885] RETIRED — see {@link NAVIGATION_VIEW_RETIRED} above the schema.
   * The tombstone stays in the shape on purpose: `tsc` types the key `never`
   * and a value reaching a parse raises the prescription instead of a bare
   * unrecognized-key report.
   */
  view: retiredKey(NAVIGATION_VIEW_RETIRED),
```

⇒ the fixture is typed **through the spec schema**, and that schema now types the key as a tombstone. The published pin (`@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`) still declares `view?: string`, which is why this compiles today and reds only under the gate.

⭐ Lit control, same instrument, same run: 80 tasks passed. `packages/plugin-grid` authors the identical literal at three call sites (`gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx:166`, `:185`, `:214`) and produced **no** diagnostic — so the gate is not reporting "the string `summary_view` appears", it is reporting one declaration's type.

## ⛔ What the repair is NOT

**Deleting the `view` member.** The file says in two places why it is there, and the reason survives the retirement:

> ⛔ The fixture keeps its `view` member on purpose — it is the one input the old and new implementations disagree about

The row it feeds asserts `onNavigate` is called with `('r1', 'view')` and **not** with `('r1', 'summary_view')`. That is a tombstone BEHAVIOUR pin: a stored body authored before 17.5.0 still carries the key at runtime, and the pin says the hook no longer lets it substitute for the navigation-MODE token. Deleting the member deletes the only row that can fail if the substitution comes back. ⛔ Do not delete it, and ⛔ do not weaken the two assertions.

Ruling **A** on #9874 (director seat, summon #25, 2026-09-20T09:04Z) is the standing direction: the landed shape stands and the retirement is real. Nothing here re-opens it.

## The repair, and the in-repo precedent for it

The declaration is carrying two jobs that the retirement has now split apart:

1. **the objectui#4550 TYPE pin** — a spec-authored config that omits `mode` is accepted by the alias. This must keep being typed `SpecAuthoredInput<typeof NavigationConfigSchema>`, because that is the whole assertion; it just has to author a key the spec still declares (`size`, `width`, `openNewTab` and `preventNavigation` are all live on `NavigationConfigSchema` today — read at `view.zod.ts:1959–1994`).
2. **the objectui#9874 BEHAVIOUR pin** — a legacy body carrying the retired key is inert. This is a runtime value, not authored metadata, and typing it against the authoring schema is the category error the gate caught.

`packages/plugin-grid` already separates them, and its way is the precedent to copy rather than invent: `gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx:93` types the input `navigation: Record<string, unknown> | undefined`, so a legacy body is fed as what it is — a stored record — and the file type-checks clean against main's spec while keeping both rows.

⚠️ Whatever shape the dev picks, the comment beside it must say WHY the legacy body is not typed through the schema, naming the retirement. A bare `as any` with no sentence is the folklore this file spent two headers fighting.

## Acceptance

- `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` is the whole file surface. ⛔ Nothing else.
- Both rows still run and still assert what they assert today; the suite is green.
- The claim to prove is the GATE's, not `tsc`'s alone: build `@objectstack/spec` from objectstack `main` the way `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject` does, install it, and show `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` going 1 diagnostic → 0. ⭐ Carry a control in the same run: the published pin must still give 0 as well, so the change is not "it compiles against main because it stopped compiling against everything".
- No changeset if the diff is test-only (confirm with the repo's own gate, ⛔ not from memory).

## Why it is worth a card

PR #9877 lands the gate. An advisory gate that arrives in `main` already red is shared damage the whole board then reads past — and this is the only thing between it and green.
